r.name: The Purbeck Ridgeway - Corfe Castle to the coast, Corfe Castle
r.description: Visit Corfe Castle & walk towards Old Harry Rocks. Vistas of Poole Harbour, Swanage & the Isle of Wight. Listen for the steam train & picnic amongst tumuli on Nine Barrow Down. Return by bus or rail. Long sections of steps, stiles, gates, slopes & mud.

r.name: Godlingston Heath walk, Purbeck Estate
r.description: This scenic walk encompasses views across the heath to Little Sea & Studland Bay & the mysterious Agglestone, a huge block of iron-rich sandstone. Short section of steps and a few boardwalks below Agglestone Rock. Gentle undulation. Seasonally muddy.

r.name: Old Harry Rocks Walk, Purbeck Estate
r.description: Take in breathtaking views of the Jurassic coast & unique rock formations on this coastal circular from South Beach in Studland, with Celtic earthworks & wildlife en route. Gentle with one steady climb up Ballard Down. Sheer cliff edges around Old Harry.
